title: Owner-authorized isolated PostgreSQL bootstrap for daily macro data
objective: Create an isolated local PostgreSQL 16 container for this project, persist a user-scoped DATABASE_URL without exposing its value, and apply only the repository's 001 and 002 additive migrations.
owner_authorization: Owner explicitly authorized creation of a PostgreSQL target after no DATABASE_URL was available to the current process.
forbidden_actions: Do not inspect, stop, restart, alter, connect to, or reuse existing containers or databases, including quantdinger-db.
Do not print, store in the repository, or include in the report any database password or full DATABASE_URL.
Do not run migrations other than db/migrations/001_initial.sql and db/migrations/002_macro_daily_metrics.sql.
Do not create a production remote database, run a historical backfill, execute Dune, or send a Hermes/Feishu message.
Do not activate BSC or Robinhood CA adapters, collectors, trading, signing, or execution capability.
deliverables: A dedicated local Docker PostgreSQL 16 container named onchain-trench-postgres on loopback port 5433.
A user-scoped DATABASE_URL available to future local sessions, with only a presence check documented.
Successful application of migrations 001 and 002, a read-only connectivity check, and a sanitized run report.
acceptance_commands: docker exec onchain-trench-postgres pg_isready -U onchain_trench -d onchain_trench
